package skipshapes

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// Shapes of `go test -v` output that the fleet's skip report has to read.

func TestPlainSkip(t *testing.T) { t.Skip("the plain reason") }

func TestSkipThenCleanupLogs(t *testing.T) {
	t.Cleanup(func() { t.Log("cleanup put things back:\nline two of the cleanup") })
	t.Log("before the skip")
	t.Skip("the reason, with the cleanup after it")
}

func TestMultiLineSkip(t *testing.T) {
	t.Skip("ran inside a child:\n=== RUN   Child\n--- PASS: Child (0.00s)\nPASS")
}

func TestSkipWithSubtests(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("sub-passes", func(t *testing.T) { t.Log("a subtest's own log") })
	t.Run("sub-skips", func(t *testing.T) { t.Skip("a subtest's skip") })
	t.Skip("the parent's reason, after its subtests")
}

func TestSilentSkip(t *testing.T) { t.SkipNow() }

func TestPasses(t *testing.T) { t.Log("a passing test's log") }

func TestParallelA(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	t.Log("A before")
	time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
	t.Skip("A's reason")
}

func TestParallelB(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	time.Sleep(20 * time.Millisecond)
	t.Log("B logs while A waits")
	time.Sleep(60 * time.Millisecond)
	t.Skip("B's reason")
}
